question: A bakery bakes 347 loaves per day for 23 days. Over that period 1289 loaves go unsold and are donated, and 4 crates of 118 loaves each are sent to a school for free. How many loaves were sold?
How many positive divisors does 7560 have?
What is the sum of all positive integers less than 500 that are divisible by 3 or by 7 (or both)?
A bat and a ball cost $1.40 in total. The bat costs $1.20 more than the ball. How many cents does the ball cost?
How many days are there from March 14, 2026 to November 2, 2026, counting both the start and end dates?
Two fair six-sided dice are rolled. What is the probability that the sum is 9? Give a reduced fraction.
What is the remainder when 3^100 is divided by 13?
How many times does the letter 'r' appear in the string "strawberry raspberry cranberry blueberry"?
Two trains start 450 km apart and travel toward each other on parallel tracks, one at 70 km/h and the other at 80 km/h. After how many minutes do they meet?
A snail is at the bottom of a 29 m well. Each day it climbs 6 m, and each night it slides back 4 m. On which day (counting the first day as day 1) does it first reach the top?
How many distinct arrangements are there of the letters of the word BANANAS?
A lattice path goes from (0,0) to (8,6) using unit steps right (+1,0) or up (0,+1). How many such paths avoid both points (3,2) and (5,4)?
How many integers n with 1 <= n <= 2026 are divisible by none of 2, 3, 5, 7?
Three cards are drawn without replacement from a standard 52-card deck. What is the probability that all three cards have different suits? Give a reduced fraction.
How many subsets of {1, 2, ..., 16} (including the empty set) have an element sum divisible by 7?

A game show has 6 doors: one hides a car, five hide goats. You pick a door. The host, who knows where the car is, then opens 2 of the other doors, always revealing goats (choosing uniformly at random among valid options). You then switch to one of the remaining 3 unopened doors (not your original), chosen uniformly at random. What is your probability of winning the car? Give a reduced fraction.

On an island, knights always tell the truth and knaves always lie. Five inhabitants A, B, C, D, E each make one statement.
A: "Exactly three of us five are knights."
B: "A is a knave."
C: "B and D are the same type (both knights or both knaves)."
D: "The number of knights among us five is even."
E: "Exactly one of C and me is a knight."
How many of the five are knights?
Find the smallest positive integer n such that n leaves remainder 4 when divided by 7, remainder 6 when divided by 11, and remainder 9 when divided by 13.
How many trailing zeros does 2026! (2026 factorial) have in base 10?
A fair coin is flipped repeatedly. What is the expected number of flips until the pattern H T H H first appears as consecutive flips? Give an integer or reduced fraction.
How many integers n with 1 <= n <= 1,000,000 have digit sum exactly 29?
How many permutations p of {1,2,...,8} satisfy p(i) != i for all i, and p(i) != i+1 for all i from 1 to 7?
In how many ways can a 4 x 7 rectangle be tiled completely with 1 x 2 dominoes?
Let S be the set of integers n with 1 <= n <= 1000 such that n^2 + n + 43 is NOT prime. What is the sum of the elements of S?

Five cards are dealt from a well-shuffled standard 52-card deck. What is the probability that the hand is exactly "two pair" (two cards of one rank, two cards of another rank, and a fifth card of a third rank)? Give a reduced fraction.
How many solutions in nonnegative integers (x1, x2, x3, x4) does x1 + 2*x2 + 3*x3 + 5*x4 = 43 have?
What are the last three digits of 7^(7^7)? Answer as an integer from 0 to 999.
How many strings of length 11 over the alphabet {A, B, C} have no two equal adjacent letters and do not contain "ABC" as a contiguous substring?

A fair six-sided die is rolled repeatedly until each of the faces 1, 2, 3 and 4 has appeared at least once (faces 5 and 6 do not matter). What is the expected number of rolls? Give a reduced fraction.

How many proper vertex colorings of the Petersen graph use at most 3 colors from a fixed set of 3 colors (adjacent vertices must receive different colors; colorings are counted as labeled assignments)?
How many ordered triples (a, b, c) of positive integers satisfy a * b * c = 9! (9 factorial)?

Seven people, including A, B and C, sit at a round table with 7 seats. Arrangements that differ only by rotation are considered the same. In how many arrangements are no two of A, B, C sitting next to each other?
Two distinct integers are chosen uniformly at random from {1, 2, ..., 100}. What is the probability that their product is divisible by 12? Give a reduced fraction.
A sequence satisfies a_1 = 2, a_2 = 5, and a_{n+2} = 3*a_{n+1} - a_n + n for n >= 1. What is a_20 mod 1000?

How many 5 x 5 matrices with entries in {0,1} have every row sum equal to 2 and every column sum equal to 2, and contain no 2 x 2 submatrix (formed by choosing any 2 rows and any 2 columns) whose four entries are all 1?
In how many ways can 6 identical kings be placed on a 5 x 5 chessboard so that no two kings attack each other (i.e., no two are in horizontally, vertically or diagonally adjacent squares)?

A gambler starts with 3 dollars and bets 1 dollar at a time, winning each bet with probability 2/5 and losing with probability 3/5, independently. He stops when he has 10 dollars or 0 dollars. What is the probability he reaches 10 dollars? Give a reduced fraction.
In how many ways can 60 be written as a sum of distinct positive odd integers, where order does not matter?
Compute the sum of Euler's totient phi(n) for n = 1, 2, ..., 200.
How many spanning trees does the 3 x 4 grid graph have? (Vertices are the 12 points (i,j) with 0<=i<=2, 0<=j<=3; edges join points at distance 1.)
A fair coin is flipped 10 times. What is the expected length of the longest run of consecutive heads (0 if there are no heads)? Give a reduced fraction.
How many 7-digit positive integers have the property that the product of their digits equals 432?
What is the remainder when the binomial coefficient C(2026, 1013) is divided by 1009? (1009 is prime.)
How many ordered pairs (a, b) of integers with 1 <= a <= 60 and 1 <= b <= 60 satisfy gcd(a, b) = 1 and a + b is prime?
